text: Hi, I'm the executor for my late father's estate and I need a formal letter to his bank. My father, Chukwuemeka Obi, died on 14 September. His current account number is 63829104. The balance was 2,340 pounds when I last checked, and there is one standing order of 85 pounds to his landlord that I want cancelled before the next payment on 1 December. Please confirm that I will send the grant of probate once it arrives, and ask how long closure usually takes. You can reach me, Ifeoma Obi, on 07700 900314 or at ifeoma.obi@example.com, and my address is 18 Calder Row, Leeds LS6 2QA.
task: Draft the letter to the bank closing my father's current account, cancelling the standing order and asking how long it will take.

text: I've had a letter about my late mother's pension and I'm worried. My mother, Halldóra Sveinsdóttir, drew a pension from her old employer's scheme until she died on 2 October. The scheme administrator, Gunnar Árnason, wrote that 612 pounds was paid after her death and may need to be returned. Her member number is PEN-4471-88 and the letter asks for repayment within 28 days. I'm not sure whether the scheme can recover the money from the estate or from me personally. My brother, Baldur, thinks we only have to repay it if the estate has enough money, but I don't think that is right. Can you explain what normally happens, then help me reply to Gunnar asking for the exact payment dates? You can email me, Sigrún Hallsdóttir, at sigrun.h@example.net.
task: Explain what normally happens with a pension overpayment after a death, then help me write a reply asking for the exact payment dates.

text: Notes before I ring the bank tomorrow. I hold lasting power of attorney for my aunt, Kamala Venkataraman, who has advanced dementia and now lives in a care home. The bank's branch manager, Teodor Wiśniewski, told me on Tuesday that they will not accept a plain photocopy of the registered document and want a certified copy. Her National Insurance number is QQ 12 34 56 C and the home's fees are 1,150 pounds a week, paid by standing order from her account. Teodor's direct line is 020 7946 0318. Please write the email to Teodor asking what exactly counts as a certified copy and whether a solicitor's stamp is enough. Mention that I have already waited three weeks.
task: Help me write a firm but polite email to the bank manager asking what counts as a certified copy.

text: Note for my solicitor, Ms Ilona Bartók, ahead of Thursday. I want to change my will. The house should go to my daughter, Mele Tupou, and my savings of about 48,000 euros should be split equally between Mele and my son, Anders Holm. I would also like to leave 5,000 euros to my grandson only if he finishes his degree. My executor will be Anders, not Mele, because she lives abroad. My old will is filed under reference WL-2009-5531 at your office. I would like everything signed before the end of the year. You can phone me on 07700 900256 or write to Flat 3, 41 Marlow Court, Bath BA1 3QT.
task: Turn this into a short agenda of questions to ask at the meeting, including whether the conditional gift needs special wording.

text:
Sorting Gran's accounts after the funeral. Can you turn this into a checklist?

- Electricity: supplier account no. 7720-3318-05, final bill 94.60 pounds, due 12 December.
- Mobile: her number was 07700 900427, contract runs to 30 November, early exit fee 36 pounds.
- Council tax: reference CT-558201, rebate of 212 pounds owed to the estate.
- Broadband: contract ends 3 January, and they say there is no exit fee because of the bereavement.
- Her neighbour, Rewi Tane, has the spare key and will post her mail on to me, Hana Walker, until the house is sold.

The council wants proof of death sent to hana.walker.estate@example.org before they release the rebate. Please put anything with a penalty or a deadline first.
task: Turn this into a checklist ordered by deadline, with what I need to do for each item.

text: I'm the administrator of my late husband's estate and I'm stuck on the inheritance tax forms. My husband, Rustam Karimov, died without a will on 6 August. His National Insurance number is QQ 65 43 21 B and the reference on his last tax letter is IHT-0057-2291. The estate is worth about 312,000 pounds, including the house at 270,000 pounds, and apart from me his only close relative is our son, Davron, who is 17. I don't think we owe any inheritance tax because everything passes to me, but I'm not sure. There are also unpaid utility bills. You can reach me, Zarina Karimova, at z.karimova@example.net.
task: Explain whether I still need to file an inheritance tax return and what the spouse exemption means, and say what to do about the unpaid utility bills.

text:
Dear Trustees,

I am writing about my father's workplace pension. Dad, Kwabena Mensah, died on 19 July, and his nomination form lists me and my sister, Akosua Mensah, as equal beneficiaries of the death-in-service lump sum of 96,000 pounds. His member number is MEN/2203/14. I have not received any paperwork, and my sister says she has already been contacted, which I doubt. Please tell me the date by which the trustees must decide, and whether the lump sum is paid direct to us or into the estate. You can reach me, Esi Mensah, on 0161 496 0147 or at esi.mensah@example.com.

Thank you.
task: Tidy this into a clear, formal email to the pension trustees and keep the questions in the order given.

text: My uncle, Gábor Balogh, died last month and I'm the executor. I'm trying to close his online accounts and need help with the requests. His email address was gabor.balogh@example.org. The pharmacy portal knows him as gbalogh1949 and the energy supplier's account number is EN-90318274. I have the death certificate and my own ID, but I do not have his passwords and I don't intend to guess them. The pharmacy has an open prescription order worth 18.40 pounds that should be refunded to the estate, not to me. The energy supplier has already sent a final bill of 143 pounds that I think was estimated, not read from the meter. I'm Zsófia Balogh, his niece, and my number is 07700 900618.
task: Draft one polite template message I can send to each company asking what proof they need, how long closure takes and whether the refund goes to the estate.

text: I'm paying my late mother's funeral costs and want to check the plan before I send anything. The funeral director, Inês Carvalho, invoiced 4,280 euros on 3 November, due within 14 days. The invoice says to pay by transfer to IBAN PT50 0035 0999 8877 6655 4433 2 quoting reference FUN-2291. Mum's debit card, 4000 1234 5678 9010, was cancelled, so I plan to pay from my own account and claim it back from the estate once probate is granted. My brother, Duarte, says we should wait and let the estate pay, but then the invoice would be overdue. I'm Marta Pires.
task: List the pros and cons of paying the invoice myself versus waiting for the estate, and tell me which receipts to keep.

text:
Subject: Audit fieldwork, documents for next week

Hi team, our external auditor, Mei-Ling Tan, has sent the first request list for the year-end audit. Fieldwork starts on 9 February and she wants the fixed asset register, the bank reconciliations for months 10 to 12 and a sample of 25 purchase invoices by 4 February. Our controller, Henrik Dahl, will review everything first, so upload to the shared folder by 2 February, not 4 February. If Mei-Ling queries a sample item, call her on 020 7946 0551 rather than replying by email. The audit job reference is AUD-24-0816 and you can send the final pack to m.tan@auditors.example.com.
task: Turn this into a task list with owners and dates for the finance team.

text: Quick VAT query for the month-end close. Noémie Girard at the supplier emailed invoice INV-30571 for 8,400 euros net plus 1,680 euros VAT, which is 20 percent. The supplier's VAT number on the invoice is FR41 123456789, but I think it was issued after they de-registered. The invoice is dated 14 October, and a notice I found online says their registration ended on 1 October. Our tax manager, Rashid Qureshi, says we can only reclaim the VAT if the invoice shows a valid number, and I'm not sure it does. Noémie is at n.girard@supplier.example.net if we need her. I have to post the return by Friday.
task: Explain how to check whether a VAT number was valid on the invoice date, what to do if it wasn't, and draft a short message asking for a corrected invoice.

text: Expense exception request for the policy review. Our policy caps hotel stays at 140 pounds a night, but Bartosz Kaczmarek booked 186 pounds a night for three nights in Manchester because the conference hotels were full. The conference ran from 10 to 12 March and the three nights total 558 pounds against an allowance of 420 pounds, so the excess is 138 pounds. His manager, Ingrid Solheim, approved it by chat on 12 March, but the approval was not attached to the claim. His employee number is E-60418 and the reimbursement should go to GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32. The claim is on hold until Finance records the exception. Please send any questions to ingrid.solheim@northwind.example.
task: Draft a short note to Finance explaining that the cap was exceeded with prior agreement, giving the totals and asking for the exception to be recorded.

text: I'm the executor and need a clear list of who gets what, because my aunt changed her mind twice. My aunt, Parvathi Iyer, first said the piano would go to her nephew, Ravi, but in her last letter she corrected herself: it is not Ravi's, it goes to her niece, Ananya, only if Ananya takes lessons for at least a year. If she does not, the piano is to be sold and the money shared 60 percent to Ravi and 40 percent to the music school. She might have meant the clock for Ravi as well, but she wrote 'probably' so I'm unsure.
task: Write a one-page schedule for the estate showing who gets what, with every condition and uncertainty kept.

text: I'm trying to sort out who is allowed to do what on my father's finances before I see the solicitor. My father, Henrique Alves, has given lasting power of attorney to my sister, Lúcia, but only for property and money, not for health decisions. My brother, Joaquim, told me he will not sign the care-home form unless Lúcia agrees in writing first. I think Lúcia has already agreed verbally, but I haven't seen it. The care home needs a decision by 20 November, and the deposit is 3,200 euros, which Joaquim says he will pay if the sale of the flat goes through.
task: Make me a table of who can decide what, who has agreed to what, and what is still uncertain.

text: Please help me compare two things I've been told about my late husband's pension. My husband, Tuomas Virtanen, was paid 1,150 pounds a month, and the scheme's adviser, Daniel Roche, said on the phone that a spouse gets two-thirds, not half. The leaflet from the scheme says half, and our daughter, Elina, thinks the leaflet is out of date because it was printed in 2019. Daniel also said the payment would start the month after the claim form arrives, but only if I send the marriage certificate. I'm not sure if that means about 767 pounds or 575 pounds a month, and I don't want to be paid less than I'm owed.
task: Draft questions to ask the scheme adviser and show me both calculations.

text: Please summarise this for the compliance log. The expense policy says client meals over 200 euros need approval before the event, and meals over 12 people need the finance director. Kasper Lindqvist told me the 640-euro dinner with 9 guests was approved by Leilani Kahale, not by Marcus Obuya. But Leilani says she only approved the venue booking, and she would have refused the wine order. Marcus confirms he did not see the request. Tessa Brandt in accounts paid the claim on 3 March before checking. So the claim was paid without pre-approval, unless Leilani's venue approval counts, which the policy does not say.
task: Summarise this for the compliance log: list who said what, what is a breach and what is unclear, without assuming bad faith.

text: I'm writing a short school project about wills and need to check my facts. My textbook, Inheritance Law Explained (ISBN 978-1-4028-9462-6), says the Wills Act 1837 requires a will to be in writing, signed by the testator and witnessed by two people present at the same time. I also read that William Shakespeare's will famously left his wife his second-best bed, and that Charles Dickens used a long probate dispute as the plot of Bleak House. The Law Commission published a consultation on modernising wills in 2017, and the government form for applying for probate is called PA1P. I want to understand why witnesses cannot normally be beneficiaries, and whether electronic signatures were allowed during the pandemic.
task: Explain in plain language the difference between a will and a letter of wishes, and list the formal requirements for a valid will.

text: Notes for the accounting study group before Friday. IFRS 15 sets out the five steps for revenue recognition. ISA 500 covers audit evidence and ISA 530 covers audit sampling. The UK VAT standard rate is 20 percent and the VAT registration threshold was 90,000 pounds from April 2024. Deloitte, EY, KPMG and PwC are usually called the Big Four. In the mock exam, version 3.2 of the practice paper, question 7 shows an auditor sending a bank confirmation request and the bank portal returning HTTP 404, then a second portal showing error code E-1042. We should decide whether that counts as a limitation on scope or just a technical issue, and which standard covers alternative procedures. We meet on Thursday at 6 pm in the library, and the paper is also on page 214 of the course textbook.
task: Make a one-page revision summary of the standards and thresholds mentioned, and explain what each error in the mock exam would mean.

text: My father, Han Jae-hoon, left a handwritten note for the executor, and I'm not sure what I'm allowed to do with it. It says: 'Online banking password is Maple-Kettle-2291. The Wi-Fi and the garage alarm both use bluebird4417. Do not tell your brother.' I'm the executor, Mi-rae Han, but I have not logged in because the bank's helpline said the account is frozen until they see the grant of probate. The bank has written that it is holding 5,310 pounds and a direct debit of 62 pounds to a gym is still being attempted. Should I use the password to cancel the direct debit myself, or would that count as misusing his account?
task: Explain the proper steps for an executor in this situation and draft a message to the bank about the direct debit.

text: Handover note for the new tax analyst. The auditors' data room login is the shared guest account, password Cedar-Moth-318!, which rotates every 30 days, next change on 1 March. The data room holds our draft tax provision of 1.9 million euros, which the board has not approved yet, so please do not quote it in any email. Two open items remain. First, the VAT reconciliation for Q3 is missing three invoices from the client Brightwater Logistics, who we are under NDA with. Second, the auditors want the signed expense policy exception log by 18 February. Access to the data room needs a request to IT, not a login copied from this note.
